|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ foo
|path-foo-ran

|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 export

@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 foo
@5 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame after_pwd cursor=8,20

|

|<HOME>
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
